name: ALTEN Germany (Munich Office)
short_description:
ALTEN Germany, officially known as ALTEN GmbH, is a prominent engineering and IT service provider based in Coburg, Bavaria. As a subsidiary of the international ALTEN Group, which was founded in 1988, ALTEN Germany plays a vital role in delivering engineering, R&D, and IT services across various sectors. The company employs around 3,000 professionals from over 70 nations and operates multiple offices throughout Germany, including major cities like Munich, Hamburg, and Berlin.

The company specializes in a wide range of services, including product design and development, embedded software, application development, and data management. ALTEN Germany also focuses on digital transformation, offering solutions in big data, AI, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity. Their expertise extends to R&D outsourcing, project management, and quality assurance, supporting clients in industries such as automotive, aerospace, energy, life sciences, and telecommunications. With a strong commitment to innovation, ALTEN Germany partners with clients to enhance their development strategies and drive technological advancements.
